scope: Proposition 2.2 (Uniform stability) of the manuscript “A continuum temperature singularity for a radial pair potential” (preprints/A-continuum-temperature-singularity-for-a-radial-pair-potential-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 228 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d3c00f7387c84c30), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Put A0 = E/8 and B0 = E/2. Every potential in (2.3) satisfies, for every finite configuration, X ℓ<k ψt(xℓ − xk) ≥ A0 X i n2 i − B0N, Uφ N ≥ (A0 − M/2) X i n2 i − B0N. (2.5) These inequalities remain valid if positive core interactions between members of a partition into unions of whole cells are deleted, or if any negative interactions are multiplied by factors in [0, 1].
